label: Local sorghum price, gap-filled (US$ per kg)
aggregation: median over county markets, monthly; gaps filled (see notes)
notes: ESTIMATES in filled cells - gap-filled version of 'price_sorghum_local_usd' (which stays observed-only). Each value is flagged in data/processed/wfp_filled_flags.csv (observed / observed_wfp_variant / observed_fewsnet / interp_time / nearby_market). Observed priority: WFP value; WFP renamed local-sorghum varieties ('Sorghum (red, local)', 'Sorghum (brown)') where WFP 'Sorghum (local)' is missing (it was not reported 2021-2023); FEWS NET retail price for counties/months without WFP data (SSP converted to USD at WFP's monthly reference rate = median price/usdprice, the same official-rate basis as WFP usdprice); (i) interp_time: interior gaps of <= 2 months in a county's own series, linear in log price (hold-out error 8%); (ii) nearby_market: county-months still empty take the inverse-distance weighted median of the up to 3 nearest markets (in other counties) with an observed price in the SAME month, all within 150 km of the county centroid; flag distance_km = nearest donor. Leave-one-county-out validation at 150 km: median abs error 24% (n=1192). Nothing is extrapolated beyond observed months.
source: WFP VAM market monitoring via HDX + FEWS NET staple food prices (FDW/HDX)
